title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

title: Cypress Test Automation Engineer
description:
Title: Cypress Test Automation Engineer

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Job Description

8+ years as a Test Automation Engineer/SDET, you will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts using tools like Cypress. You will work closely with development teams to design robust, scalable, and efficient test automation frameworks and strategies, ensuring that the products meet the highest standards of quality. Your role will be crucial in building and optimizing automated tests for web applications across various browsers and environments, focusing on continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:

• Test Automation Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive test automation strategies, ensuring thorough coverage of both functional and non-functional testing requirements.

• Automated Test Script Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, and other relevant tools, ensuring compatibility with various browsers and platforms.

• Framework Development: Create and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks, incorporating best practices and design patterns such as Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven, or Keyword-Driven frameworks.

• Continuous Integration: Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI, ensuring automated tests run efficiently in every build and release.

• Test Execution & Reporting: Execute automated tests in different environments and ensure they are executed with the correct data sets, logging, and reporting outcomes. Analyze test results and provide actionable insights.

• Collaboration: Work closely with QA, DevOps, and Development teams to ensure seamless integration of test automation processes into the development lifecycle.

• Bug Reporting & Tracking: Identify and report issues and bugs in the system, assisting development teams in reproducing and debugging issues.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Experience: hands-on experience in test automation with Selenium and Cypress , with a proven track record of successfully automating complex web applications.

• Selenium Expertise: Strong expertise in Selenium WebDriver for automating functional tests, including experience with various browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, etc.).

• Cypress Expertise : Proficiency in writing and maintaining tests using Cypress, including handling different testing needs like end-to-end, integration, and performance testing.

• Test Automation Frameworks: Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining test automation frameworks using patterns like Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven Testing, and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

• Programming Languages: Strong coding skills in languages like Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.

• Version Control: Proficient in using Git for source control and managing automation repositories.

• Test Case Design & Reporting: Experience designing detailed test cases, test scripts, and generating clear and actionable test reports.

• Cross-Browser Testing: Experience with cross-browser testing and cross-platform compatibility in automated tests.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues

  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

  • Selecionar e implementar ferramentas tecnológicas chave
  • Garantir escalabilidade, eficiência e adoção das soluções


Requisitos


Experiência Profissional

  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em tecnologia, inovação ou transformação digital
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Implementação de soluções baseadas em IA, dados ou automação
  • Pré-venda técnica em ambientes de tecnologia, BPO ou consultoria
  • Arquitetura de dados
  • Liderança de times técnicos
  • Atuação direta em geração de receita e fechamento de negócios

  • Inteligência Artificial (Machine Learning, GenAI)
  • Arquitetura de dados e plataformas em nuvem
  • Automação de processos (RPA, workflows)
  • Metodologias ágeis


Exemplos de tecnologias:

  • Dados: SQL, Python, ferramentas de BI

title: Cypress Test Automation Engineer
description:
Title: Cypress Test Automation Engineer

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Job Description

8+ years as a Test Automation Engineer/SDET, you will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts using tools like Cypress. You will work closely with development teams to design robust, scalable, and efficient test automation frameworks and strategies, ensuring that the products meet the highest standards of quality. Your role will be crucial in building and optimizing automated tests for web applications across various browsers and environments, focusing on continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:

• Test Automation Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive test automation strategies, ensuring thorough coverage of both functional and non-functional testing requirements.

• Automated Test Script Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, and other relevant tools, ensuring compatibility with various browsers and platforms.

• Framework Development: Create and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks, incorporating best practices and design patterns such as Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven, or Keyword-Driven frameworks.

• Continuous Integration: Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI, ensuring automated tests run efficiently in every build and release.

• Test Execution & Reporting: Execute automated tests in different environments and ensure they are executed with the correct data sets, logging, and reporting outcomes. Analyze test results and provide actionable insights.

• Collaboration: Work closely with QA, DevOps, and Development teams to ensure seamless integration of test automation processes into the development lifecycle.

• Bug Reporting & Tracking: Identify and report issues and bugs in the system, assisting development teams in reproducing and debugging issues.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Experience: hands-on experience in test automation with Selenium and Cypress , with a proven track record of successfully automating complex web applications.

• Selenium Expertise: Strong expertise in Selenium WebDriver for automating functional tests, including experience with various browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, etc.).

• Cypress Expertise : Proficiency in writing and maintaining tests using Cypress, including handling different testing needs like end-to-end, integration, and performance testing.

• Test Automation Frameworks: Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining test automation frameworks using patterns like Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven Testing, and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

• Programming Languages: Strong coding skills in languages like Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.

• Version Control: Proficient in using Git for source control and managing automation repositories.

• Test Case Design & Reporting: Experience designing detailed test cases, test scripts, and generating clear and actionable test reports.

• Cross-Browser Testing: Experience with cross-browser testing and cross-platform compatibility in automated tests.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Senior Data Scientist/AI Engineer
description:
Location: Brasil (Remote/Hybrid) | Experience: 6+ Years | Core Stack: Python, PySpark, Azure Databricks, LLMs, MLflow | Workplace Type: Remote

The Opportunity

KPIT is seeking a high-caliber Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer to architect and deliver end-to-end, production-grade AI and Machine Learning solutions. This is not just a research role; it is a hands-on engineering position designed for a specialist who can bridge the gap between complex mathematical modeling and scalable cloud deployment. You will lead the development of next-generation AI agents and scalable data pipelines on Azure, turning massive datasets into intelligent, autonomous workflows that drive real business value.

Technical Leadership & AI Engineering

  • End-to-End AI Ownership: Take full accountability for the AI lifecycle—from initial problem definition and data discovery to the deployment and monitoring of production-grade models.
  • Agentic AI & Generative AI: Spearhead the development of advanced Agentic AI workflows , implementing multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and autonomous decision-making capabilities using modern GenAI frameworks.
  • Scalable Data Engineering: Architect and maintain high-performance data pipelines using PySpark and Spark within the Azure Databricks ecosystem.
  • MLOps & Lifecycle Management: Implement robust MLOps practices using MLflow to track experiments, manage deployments, and ensure seamless model versioning.
  • Production Reliability: Design sophisticated monitoring systems to track model performance, detect data drift, and ensure the long-term reliability and integrity of AI in live environments.

Technical Expertise Required (Must Have)

  • 5–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering.
  • Advanced Python & SQL: Expert-level coding skills for data manipulation, algorithm development, and database interaction.
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Proven hands-on experience with PySpark, Spark, and Azure Databricks .
  • Cloud Native AI: Strong experience delivering and scaling ML solutions within the Microsoft Azure environment.
  • Generative AI Expertise: Practical experience with LLMs and AI Agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain or Semantic Kernel ).
  • MLOps Proficiency: Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, evaluation techniques, and MLflow .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

The Differentiators

  • Advanced Orchestration: Experience building complex, multi-agent systems that interact with external tools/APIs.
  • Architectural Depth: Ability to design not just the model, but the entire data-to-inference architecture.
  • Mentorship: A track record of elevating engineering standards and mentoring junior data scientists.

Who You Are

  • An Architect: You don't just build models; you build scalable, production-ready systems.
  • A Lifelong Learner: You stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving GenAI and Agentic AI landscape.
  • A Business Translator: You can translate vague business problems into precise technical requirements and measurable AI outcomes.

The Reward

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Opportunity to work with the latest in Agentic AI and Large Language Models.
  • Competitive Compensation: Salary packages that recognize your specialized AI/ML expertise.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical and dental insurance.
  • Vouchers: Competitive VR/VA package and more.
  • Career Growth: Clear progression and leadership opportunities within a global technology leader.
  • Impact: Drive the AI-led digital transformation of the global automotive and mobility ecosystem.

About KPIT

KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem, delivering end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. We help shape the future of mobility by integrating intelligence into every aspect of the vehicle and the driving experience.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

  • Spring Boot / Batch
  • Azure ServiceBus / RabbitMQ
  • Oracle / MongoDB
  • Git, Jenkins, Grafana
  • Testes com JUnit 4 e 5 (Jupiter)
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em port and adapters e coreografia de eventos
  • Vivência em ambiente ágil
  • Perfil comprometido, questionador, curioso, detalhista, hands-on
  • Diferencial: Node.js.

  • Liderança técnica e desenvolvimento em arquitetura de microsserviços com Java e Spring
  • Integração com mensagerias, bancos relacionais e não relacionais
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de testes e automações
  • Criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e resilientes

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

This role is for the person who:

  • Wants to help founders of eCommerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
  • Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
  • Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged.


The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.

To support our continued growth, this is an active position we’re currently recruiting for.


About UpCounting

We’re a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping eCommerce and digital-first businesse s scale with confidence.

Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote (UGC, Beauty/Skincare)
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

  • Contribute to the development and management of knowledge-sharing methodologies, diagnostic tools, and creative processes, to improve the end user experience.
  • Be a pro-active contributor to a 24x7x365 running support organization, this will require working flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays and monitoring email regularly outside standard business hours.


Additional Duties & Responsibilities

  • Review technical solutions and documentation developed by other team members
  • Mentor and cross train other team members

  • Platform Developer II Certification
  • Platform App Builder Certification
  • Experience in Lightning Web Components


Education

Experience

  • Minimum combined 10 years development experience with CRM applications with 4+ years of hands-on development with Salesforce
  • 4+ years of development in medium to large complexity Salesforce Orgs
  • Deep expertise of Salesforce architecture, administration, best practices, and CRM business concepts.
  • Experience with post-production managed services and support


Skills

  • Hands on Development with Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and communication skills – verbal & written. Ability to communicate at business level with stakeholders and technical level with developers.
  • Practical knowledge of APIs to integrate Salesforce with other data sources.
  • Expertise in customization of Mobile App.
  • Superb trouble-shooting skills and tenacity in problem solving.
  • Strong knowledge of key application functionality, data security, and relationships.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally in high pressure situations.

Desired Qualifications

  • A consulting background, while not mandatory, would be useful

title: Application Security (AppSec) Engineer Pleno - Foco em DevSecOps
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Analista de Application Security (AppSec) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a segurança das aplicações desde o desenvolvimento até a produção, atuando de forma próxima aos times de engenharia para prevenir vulnerabilidades e fortalecer a cultura de segurança dentro dos projetos.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Segurança em IA: Atuar diretamente com squads de Inteligência Artificial, garantindo a segurança e resiliência de agentes autônomos.
  • Segurança Multicloud: Operar o hardening de ambientes (IAM, Redes, Gestão de Segredos) em AWS, Azure, GCP e OCI.
  • Cultura DevSecOps: Implementar e evoluir stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, Secrets) no GitLab CI/CD, garantindo automação total.
  • Parceria com Squads: Apoiar desenvolvedores na triagem, priorização e correção de vulnerabilidades via code review e práticas de Secure SDLC.
  • Proposição Técnica: Definir padrões de segurança para APIs (REST/GraphQL) e arquiteturas modernas, focando em soluções e não apenas em apontar problemas.
  • Disseminação de Conhecimento: Promover treinamentos e workshops para elevar a barra de segurança dos times de engenharia.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Perfil Híbrido: Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de software e transição consolidada para Application Security (AppSec).
  • Automação: Capacidade de desenvolver scripts (Python ou Bash) para automação de tarefas de segurança e resposta a incidentes.
  • GitLab: Experiência prática em configurar pipelines de CI/CD integrando ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep, Snyk ou SonarQube.
  • Fundamentos de Cyber: Sólidos conhecimentos em autenticação, autorização (RBAC/IAM), WAF, EDR e OWASP Top 10.
  • Gestão de Segredos: Familiaridade com ferramentas de Vault (Hashicorp, AWS, Azure, GCP ou OCI).
  • Comunicação Proativa: Habilidade para transitar entre discussões técnicas de código e apresentações de métricas/soluções (powerpoint) para stakeholders.
  • Cloud: Conhecimentos de desenvolvimento em alguma das 4 clouds (AWS, GCP, OCI e Azure)


Diferenciais:

  • Domínio Técnico: Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise (Trivy, Semgrep, Snyk, SonarQube ou similares).
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Familiaridade com segurança em containers e ferramentas como Checkov ou Prowler.
  • Certificações: Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) ou segurança (Security+, CEH, CSSLP).
  • Modelagem de Ameaças: Experiência prática com Threat Modeling.
  • Segurança Ofensiva: Conhecimentos em PenTest, Redes e ferramentas como OWASP ZAP ou Burp Suite.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Senior Data Scientist/AI Engineer
description:
Location: Brasil (Remote/Hybrid) | Experience: 6+ Years | Core Stack: Python, PySpark, Azure Databricks, LLMs, MLflow | Workplace Type: Remote

The Opportunity

KPIT is seeking a high-caliber Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer to architect and deliver end-to-end, production-grade AI and Machine Learning solutions. This is not just a research role; it is a hands-on engineering position designed for a specialist who can bridge the gap between complex mathematical modeling and scalable cloud deployment. You will lead the development of next-generation AI agents and scalable data pipelines on Azure, turning massive datasets into intelligent, autonomous workflows that drive real business value.

Technical Leadership & AI Engineering

  • End-to-End AI Ownership: Take full accountability for the AI lifecycle—from initial problem definition and data discovery to the deployment and monitoring of production-grade models.
  • Agentic AI & Generative AI: Spearhead the development of advanced Agentic AI workflows , implementing multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and autonomous decision-making capabilities using modern GenAI frameworks.
  • Scalable Data Engineering: Architect and maintain high-performance data pipelines using PySpark and Spark within the Azure Databricks ecosystem.
  • MLOps & Lifecycle Management: Implement robust MLOps practices using MLflow to track experiments, manage deployments, and ensure seamless model versioning.
  • Production Reliability: Design sophisticated monitoring systems to track model performance, detect data drift, and ensure the long-term reliability and integrity of AI in live environments.

Technical Expertise Required (Must Have)

  • 5–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering.
  • Advanced Python & SQL: Expert-level coding skills for data manipulation, algorithm development, and database interaction.
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Proven hands-on experience with PySpark, Spark, and Azure Databricks .
  • Cloud Native AI: Strong experience delivering and scaling ML solutions within the Microsoft Azure environment.
  • Generative AI Expertise: Practical experience with LLMs and AI Agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain or Semantic Kernel ).
  • MLOps Proficiency: Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, evaluation techniques, and MLflow .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

The Differentiators

  • Advanced Orchestration: Experience building complex, multi-agent systems that interact with external tools/APIs.
  • Architectural Depth: Ability to design not just the model, but the entire data-to-inference architecture.
  • Mentorship: A track record of elevating engineering standards and mentoring junior data scientists.

Who You Are

  • An Architect: You don't just build models; you build scalable, production-ready systems.
  • A Lifelong Learner: You stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving GenAI and Agentic AI landscape.
  • A Business Translator: You can translate vague business problems into precise technical requirements and measurable AI outcomes.

The Reward

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Opportunity to work with the latest in Agentic AI and Large Language Models.
  • Competitive Compensation: Salary packages that recognize your specialized AI/ML expertise.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical and dental insurance.
  • Vouchers: Competitive VR/VA package and more.
  • Career Growth: Clear progression and leadership opportunities within a global technology leader.
  • Impact: Drive the AI-led digital transformation of the global automotive and mobility ecosystem.

About KPIT

KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem, delivering end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. We help shape the future of mobility by integrating intelligence into every aspect of the vehicle and the driving experience.

  • Production Reliability: Design sophisticated monitoring systems to track model performance, detect data drift, and ensure the long-term reliability and integrity of AI in live environments.

Technical Expertise Required (Must Have)

  • 5–6 years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering.
  • Advanced Python & SQL: Expert-level coding skills for data manipulation, algorithm development, and database interaction.
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Proven hands-on experience with PySpark, Spark, and Azure Databricks .
  • Cloud Native AI: Strong experience delivering and scaling ML solutions within the Microsoft Azure environment.
  • Generative AI Expertise: Practical experience with LLMs and AI Agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain or Semantic Kernel ).
  • MLOps Proficiency: Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, evaluation techniques, and MLflow .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

The Differentiators

  • Advanced Orchestration: Experience building complex, multi-agent systems that interact with external tools/APIs.
  • Architectural Depth: Ability to design not just the model, but the entire data-to-inference architecture.
  • Mentorship: A track record of elevating engineering standards and mentoring junior data scientists.

Who You Are

  • An Architect: You don't just build models; you build scalable, production-ready systems.

  • A Business Translator: You can translate vague business problems into precise technical requirements and measurable AI outcomes.

The Reward

  • Competitive Compensation: Salary packages that recognize your specialized AI/ML expertise.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical and dental insurance.
  • Vouchers: Competitive VR/VA package and more.
  • Career Growth: Clear progression and leadership opportunities within a global technology leader.
  • Impact: Drive the AI-led digital transformation of the global automotive and mobility ecosystem.

About KPIT

KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem, delivering end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. We help shape the future of mobility by integrating intelligence into every aspect of the vehicle and the driving experience.

description:

Job Description: Server Manager (Global Project)

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.

  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .

  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).

Lead development and implementation of complex information technology projects and architecture to solve problems with wide impact, requiring high levels of functional integration.

The Technical Lead acts as the primary architectural authority and engineering manager for the platform. This hands-on role is responsible for architecting scalable technical solutions, managing the engineering team, and working closely with the Product Team and Business Leadership to build AI-powered tools that deliver measurable value.


Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Technical Architecture & Strategy

  • Architect, design, and provide hands-on contribution to the development and deployment of scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions that support business goals and product initiatives.
  • Make technical design choices and follow technical standards, including cyber security, software languages, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Balance fast, lean innovation with practical implementation, technical feasibility, technical debt, and system stability in production environments.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to platform needs and understand risk mitigation strategies.

Engineering Leadership & Priorities

  • Manage the engineering team in alignment with product roadmap and critical deadlines.
  • Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical specs and engineering tasks.
  • Mentor software developers, conduct code reviews, and ensure high-quality coding.
